note: One line per take. Each take is generated separately, then placed on the timeline with meaning pauses between. Spoken numbers are spelled the way they're said.

lines.text: You've been carrying it alone... for a long time.
The late nights.
The habit you hide.
The words you can't take back.
The bitterness you call fine.
The empty, after the party ends.
And that quiet ache... nothing fixes.
But hear me. You are not too far gone.
Not too late. Not too much.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
The dayspring from on high hath visited us.
Dayspring Chapel. A parish of The Redeemed Christian Church of God, right here in Houston.
A home in Houston. Service times, directions, and a plan for your first Sunday.
Pastors Joel and Funmi Uzoma. Together in ministry since nineteen ninety five.
Every nation. One family.
So picture this Sunday.
Ten thirty. Someone holds the door.
The first song starts.
You sit down. You breathe.
Bring it. Set it down.
Come as you are.
Sunday worship, ten thirty, on Hartsook Street. Plan your visit at r c c g dayspring dot org.
